description: Infeasibility — 5 candidates, pick K=3, but 3 dims are each covered by only 1 unique candidate — needs all 3 unique candidates plus 0 more, can't also cover the remaining dims
notes: dim 8 (geo_apac) only covered by comp_d. dims 7 (deploy_onprem) only by comp_c. So both c and d must be selected. With K=3, one slot left for {a,b,e} — none of which cover both pricing_flat(1) AND channel_content(3) AND buyer_exec(5). Only comp_b covers those, so selecting {b,c,d} misses dims 0,2,4. UNSAT.
